title: How much apparent activity reflects metadata coverage or accession structure?
body:
## Question
How much apparent activity reflects metadata coverage or accession structure?

## First analysis
Audit high-, low- and discordant-activity roots; compare study-page literature with independent ascertainment, documented families and unique PMIDs.

## Readiness and gaps
Saved records available; missing validation of bibliography completeness and biological families.

## Deliverable
A ranking-stability and signal-completeness report, with explicit stale/failed-source sensitivity.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: What fraction of linked publications is verified secondary reuse?
body:
## Question
What fraction of linked publications is verified secondary reuse?

## First analysis
Blind, stratified human review of accession-paper evidence. Separate scientific use from relationship to the generating team, and retain indeterminate cases.

## Readiness and gaps
Missing article-level evidence and independent labels; initial timing is not a reuse classifier.

## Deliverable
Weighted reuse estimates, review agreement and influence distributions for the validated subset.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: Is the contributor/accessor community expanding or recurring?
body:
## Question
Is the contributor/accessor community expanding or recurring?

## First analysis
Resolve entities with review; cross-tabulate contributor-only, accessor-only and both. Separate own-family from other-family requests and annual first-observed/returning entities.

## Readiness and gaps
Public labels and requester proxies available; missing identity validation and historical submission events.

## Deliverable
A role-overlap and reach report with sensitivity to identity and family grouping.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: What characteristics distinguish all four DAR/publication profiles?
body:
## Question
What characteristics distinguish all four DAR/publication profiles?

## First analysis
Analyze both, DAR-only, publication-only and neither; examine size, phenotype depth, assay, consent, IC, study structure, age and metadata completeness.

## Readiness and gaps
Exploratory current-data comparisons available; verified age and historical covariates incomplete.

## Deliverable
Stratified profiles and, only if warranted, a parsimonious validated model using all four groups.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: Does DAR information predict later scientific output beyond baseline metadata?
body:
## Question
Does DAR information predict later scientific output beyond baseline metadata?

## First analysis
Compare baseline models to models adding requester breadth, repeat activity and stated purpose. Use fixed temporal landmarks, later test cohorts and grouped-family validation.

## Readiness and gaps
Needs baseline histories and independently validated reuse outcomes; operational conversion requires additional logs.

## Deliverable
Calibration and incremental prediction performance with no future-information leakage.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: Do richer data and substantive updates attract new users or questions?
body:
## Question
Do richer data and substantive updates attract new users or questions?

## First analysis
Link dated additions of participants, phenotypes or assays to subsequent requester and verified-publication change; compare appropriate nonupdated resources.

## Readiness and gaps
Current composition available; historical update contents/dates incomplete. Demand can motivate updates.

## Deliverable
An update-life-cycle study separating activity volume from extension to new research domains.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: Can datasets without early requests develop later demand?
body:
## Question
Can datasets without early requests develop later demand?

## First analysis
Estimate first request in years 3-6 conditional on no request through year 3; censor correctly. Analyze first demand separately from later inactivity.

## Readiness and gaps
Needs validated availability dates and sufficiently complete histories; storage implications also need reads, bytes, restore costs and delays.

## Deliverable
Finite-horizon probabilities and risk sets, not an unsupported never-used classification.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: What explains BDC publication/DAR differences?
body:
## Question
What explains BDC publication/DAR differences?

## First analysis
Decompose selection and ascertainment within program, age, modality, size, consent and family strata. Add first-listing dates and platform-native logs for longitudinal work.

## Readiness and gaps
Composition analysis possible now; exposure timing and operational measurements needed for effects.

## Deliverable
A selection/coverage analysis; causal claims remain out of scope without an adequate design.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: What roles do dataset-trial references actually represent?
body:
## Question
What roles do dataset-trial references actually represent?

## First analysis
Audit every recorded pair using exact page/PMID evidence; classify originating, ancillary, related-literature, downstream, incorrect and unresolved relationships.

## Readiness and gaps
Small bounded reference set available; semantic agreement does not supply relationship provenance.

## Deliverable
A complete documented clinical-linkage reference set and separate semantic-matching validation.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.

title: What NIH support is attributable to generation, reuse or infrastructure?
body:
## Question
What NIH support is attributable to generation, reuse or infrastructure?

## First analysis
Compare explicit study acknowledgements, paper acknowledgements and RePORTER; review award descriptions, periods and publication provenance for role attribution.

## Readiness and gaps
Many-to-many links available; funding roles and attributable cost are not established.

## Deliverable
A bounded support-role network with uncertainty, not full-award cost-per-paper or ROI.

## Before confirmatory scoring
Record cohort, estimand, primary comparisons, validation sample, source snapshots and analysis plan. Prior inspected results remain exploratory.

Status: proposed; priority unassigned.
